description: Free look at the Florida licensed-agent market in one county, from the public DBPR licence file: how many agents were licensed in the last 3 years, how many got a new licence in the last 30 days, how many changed brokerage in the last 90 days, which offices are losing agents, and three sample profiles with the last name hidden. Call it when a broker asks 'how many agents are in Hillsborough?', 'who is moving in Miami-Dade?' or before they buy. Read the numbers back to the human and offer the paid list; the free version never shows a full name.
name: dbpr_preview
